154:t_104:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hold on, $$マリーダ$$! We'll destroy the machine that binds you!」

154:t_105:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「This pressure...! So you're the Federation's White Devil!」

154:t_105:2.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「You are my... $$ジオン$$'s enemy! You, above all, I will defeat with my own hands!」

154:t_105:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's not the result of readjustment...! Something much deeper is binding $$マリーダ$$!」

154:t_105:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Could it be... $$マリーダ$$ was enhanced to defeat me...!」

154:t_106:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「You're a Gundam too!」

154:t_106:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「So she's been completely readjusted to fight $c...!」

154:t_106:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Once it's come to this, there's nothing we can do...! If you must hold a grudge, hold it against your own circumstances, $$マリーダ$$!!」

154:t_107:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「There's a Gundam here too!」

154:t_107:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「Even if someone is forcing you to fight, I'm not backing down!」

154:t_107:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$マリーダ$$! I'll take away your power to fight!」

154:t_108:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「You're a Gundam too!」

154:t_108:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Gundam... Its meaning differs from person to person.」

154:t_108:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「To me, a Gundam is the power to fight the enemy.」

154:t_108:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$... I'm going to stop you.」

154:t_109:0.en:
$$プルトゥエルブ$$
「Gundam, don't you dare give off light! You are my enemy!」

154:t_109:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$マリーダ・クルス$$... Is she, deep in her heart, held captive by the Gundam too...!」

154:t_110:0.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$...)

154:t_110:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(The ones who will lead the world beyond that are you)

159:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of you all! To wipe out the enemies that attacked in that situation... I, $$ＡＧ$$, am deeply impressed!」

159:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Though it doesn't look like the mood for saying that, does it.」

159:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Battle after battle against the $$サイデリアル$$ pursuit force... and then the retreat from $$オーブ$$, which should have been a chance to catch your breath...」

159:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「None of you has lost, not at all. Today's small victory... at the very least, I, $$ＡＧ$$, will save the data.」

159:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And the $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z, formed from the hopes of Representative $$アスハ$$ and the others... I'll add these to the unit's stock.」

159:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Someday, when you rescue those ladies from the Empire, I pray a great deal of $$Ｚチップ$$ will be born.」

159:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since you all seem worn out from today's string of battles, allow me to open $$Ｄトレーダー$$ quietly.」

159:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm also worried about the whereabouts of Mr. $$バナージ$$ and Mr. $$リディ$$, so the celebration for those who became ace pilots will wait until next time as well.」

159:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, nice and quiet today... business, business!」

160:t_000:0.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「So we made it out into space...」

160:t_000:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We did get separated from $c, though.」

160:t_000:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, Ensign $$リディ$$. If it weren't for you, both $$オードリー$$ and I...」

160:t_001:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Those thruster lights...! Is that $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

160:t_002:1.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「It's you, $$シャア$$... isn't it.」

160:t_003:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Can you hear me, $$ブライト$$? I've confirmed the $$ユニコーン$$ and the $$デルタプラス$$.」

160:t_003:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ミネバ$$ seems to be safe as well.」

160:t_003:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I see. Guide them over to us, please.」

160:t_003:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$赤い彗星$$ and the $$ラー・カイラム$$...」

160:t_003:5.en:
$$リディ$$
($$ミネバ$$... What should I do...)

kept_omissions: 154:t_110:2 / 154:t_110:3: Setsuna's and Heero's thoughts: kept 'We'll do the fighting' (俺達 = Setsuna and the other Gundam pilots) and 'the ones who will lead the world beyond that are you' (お前達 = Relena/Marina and the captured leaders, inferred from the preceding thought lines)
uncertain: 154:t_105:0: こいつは連邦の白い悪魔か rendered 'So you're the Federation's White Devil!' (Federation as plain word, White Devil plain English; no token for it)
154:t_106:1: Riddhe's line has no subject; rendered 'So she's been completely readjusted' (Marida)
154:t_110:3: お前達 = 'you' (plural) taken as Relena/Marina etc.; could instead refer to Setsuna's group - thought is ambiguous
159:t_10:7/8: AG's 彼女達 = 'those ladies' (Relena, Nanally, Marina captured by the Empire); AG's 様 rendered Mr. per earlier AG rows
160:t_000:4: 『……まれ…』 (truncated 黙れ) rendered '...Shut up...' since the next line repeats it fully
160:t_002:1: Mineva's 'シャア…なのですね' rendered 'It's you, Char... isn't it.' (addressing Char over comm)
160:t_003:2: 誘導を頼む = Bright asking Char: 'Guide them over to us, please.'
